description: Fix inaccurate location (user item 2: 'fix the location, make it accurate'). The direct cause is lib/features/location/data/location_repository.dart using LocationAccuracy.low. Raise accuracy to high and add a sensible timeout so a fix cannot hang indefinitely, keeping the existing typed-exception handling and demo-mode behaviour intact. Verify the manifest permissions the setup scripts add already include ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION (they do). Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-004.
steps: In lib/features/location/data/location_repository.dart, change the LocationSettings accuracy from LocationAccuracy.low to LocationAccuracy.high (best is acceptable but high is the documented, battery-reasonable choice for a one-shot foreground fix). Add a timeLimit (e.g. const Duration(seconds: 15)) to LocationSettings so getCurrentPosition cannot hang forever.

Ensure a TimeoutException / LocationServiceDisabledException from getCurrentPosition is translated into an AppException by the existing flow. Check lib/core/errors/error_mapper.dart: if geolocator's TimeoutException is not already mapped to a sensible AppErrorKind (e.g. locationServicesDisabled or a generic location error), map it so LocationController.useMyLocation surfaces a friendly message rather than an unhandled error. If a new AppErrorKind or message is needed, add it and localize its message in ErrorMapper/validation_messages with EN+AR ARB keys wired through all 5 l10n files.
Keep the demo-mode early return (Amman sample) and all existing permission checks unchanged.

Confirm both tool/setup_platforms.sh and tool/setup_platforms.ps1 add ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION (they do) and the iOS NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription (present). No script change is expected for accuracy alone; only touch the scripts if a new capability is genuinely required (it is not for high accuracy).

Add/extend a unit test: if error_mapper gained a mapping, add a case in test/unit/error_mapper_test.dart. If no mapper change was needed, add a small test asserting the repository uses high accuracy is impractical (geolocator is a plugin); instead document the change and rely on analyze. Prefer adding an error_mapper test only if the mapper actually changed.
acceptance_criteria: location_repository.dart requests LocationAccuracy.high (or best) with a finite timeLimit; low accuracy no longer used.
getCurrentPosition timing out yields a handled AppException surfaced through LocationController rather than an uncaught exception.
Demo mode still returns the sample location; permission and services-disabled paths unchanged.
If any new user-visible message was added, EN+AR ARB parity holds and all 5 l10n files updated.
flutter analyze clean and existing tests still pass (verified by the user).
verification: grep -n 'LocationAccuracy' lib/features/location/data/location_repository.dart shows high/best and no remaining .low
python3 parity + getter-coverage harness pass if any l10n key was added
User runs: flutter analyze && flutter test
